scorecard.rationale: A state-anxiety comparison favored a dried berry mixture with 16.7% raspberry over cocoa in an exploratory healthy-volunteer analysis. The frozen-fruit thesis measured oxidative biomarkers. The recovered isolated ketone paper assessed depression-like behavior in mice, and the human raspberry powder experiment has no separate anxiety estimate. The direction for frozen raspberry and Parkinson anxiety remains unresolved. The reviewed raspberry experiment uses extract and DNA or cell injury measures. It supplies no comparison for frozen raspberry and anxiety.
